name: Muko-sama! ~Totsuzen no Virgin Road~
original_name: 婿さまっ！～突然のバージンロード～
source:
You’re an ordinary working girl when your less-than-optimistic wish for a boyfriend is answered by your estranged gramps via his almost-magical butler.

Twenty-four hours is all it takes between Genie Butler bringing you to your ultra-rich grandfather in a limo, and said relative asking you to choose your fiancé in front of a ballroom of strangers.

[from [url=https://sassandscribbles.com/2018/12/12/first-impressions-wanted-son-in-law-okko/]Sass and Scribbles[/url]]
translation:
你是一个普通的职业女孩，当你对男朋友的不太乐观的愿望得到了你疏远的爷爷通过他近乎神奇的管家的满足。

从吉尼·巴特勒开着豪华轿车带你去见你超级富有的祖父，到亲戚要求你在一群陌生人的舞厅前选择你的未婚夫，只需要二十四小时。

[来自[url=https://sassandscribbles.com/2018/12/12/first-impressions-wanted-son-in-law-okko/]Sass和Scribbles[/url]]
